Rae (CS): HaloHealth raised three onboarding blockers in today's call. Renewal check in ~5 weeks. Can product/eng help prioritize?
Omar (CS): Notes: 
- Relevance: after CSV ingest search returns marketing blurbs, not clinical SOPs.
- Billing: they want per-route separation so test/staging traffic doesn't inflate prod costs.
- Backfill: large imports fail at ~35k rows with no retry.
Pri (PM): My take: relevance is P0 (blocks adoption), per-route billing P1 (commercial), backfill reliability P2.
Kai (ENG): Can we get a sanitized sample and a request id to repro? Also which ingestion path (UI vs API)?
Rae (CS): They used the API importer. Sample (sanitized):
```
{"text":"Central line dressing change checklist","model":"open-sim-1.0","metadata":{"customer":"halo-prod"}}
```
Request id: halo-req-2026-12-02-009.
Omar (CS): Customer quote: "Search brings up our blog and press release snippets instead of the SOPs we just uploaded."
notify-bot: Created ticket CS-7345 and linked ENG-2689.
Kai (ENG): I'll take a 48h triage. Plan: reproduce with the payload, check model routing, tokenization edge cases, and nearest-neighbor scores across vectorstores. If routing looks fine, try a tighter similarity cutoff as a mitigation.
Pri (PM): Plan: 1) ENG triage (48h) owner Kai. 2) Product RFC for per-route billing (next sprint). 3) CS to collect 2 more samples + impact quotes for renewal memo.
Rae (CS): I'll collect samples today and tell Halo we'll share a triage update in 48h.
Omar (CS): I'll schedule a 20-min enablement session post-mitigation.
Kai (ENG): Starting repro now; will post findings in this thread.
Rae (CS): Thanks team  keeping this open until ENG posts root cause.
